subject: Action items & SLO proposal for dedicated inference pool (MedNova)
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@mednova.com>; infra-team@mednova.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Action items & SLO proposal for dedicated inference pool (MedNova)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard from your team and the proposed next steps so we keep momentum for a Dedicated pool engagement: 

Pain points you confirmed:
- Erratic tail latency during peak scheduling windows (5–8pm PT) impacting triage workflows
- Need for data isolation for PHI workloads and a clear audit trail for every inference request
- Predictable unit economics for planning procurement (monthly committed spend)

Goals we agreed on:
- Dedicated GPU pool sized for ~1k concurrent inference sessions with median p95 token latency < 120ms
- Tenant isolation and KMS integration for keys in your VPC
- SLA with 99.9% availability and a runbook + escalation path for severity 1 incidents

Proposed technical SLOs (first draft attached as "redwood-sla-proposal-v1.pdf"):
- P95 latency (inference request complete): 120ms 
- P99 latency: 450ms (with burst policy offload to queued pool)
- Availability: 99.9% monthly uptime
- On-call notification to MedNova ops within 15 minutes of Sev1

Immediate next steps (who / when):
1) MedNova infra to validate network egress and KMS endpoint — infra-team@mednova.com (by 2026-07-06)
2) Redwood ops (Ben + Monica) to run a proof-of-fit: 72-hour performance trial with your representative data slice (we can start as soon as NDA & sample data access are in place) — Ben/Monica (target kickoff 2026-07-12)
3) Procurement engagement: share estimated monthly commitment and initial contract terms for review — Maya to loop Procurement (this thread) by EOD 6/29
4) Security artifacts: we shared SOC2 + compliance pack; Sara will confirm any additional evidence needed

Attachments included: SLA proposal (v1), isolation ops playbook (draft), SOC2 statement

If this matches your view, please reply with any corrections and confirm who from your team will own the KMS/network validation item. Once we have that we’ll send a short MOP and the proof-of-fit intake form.

Thanks — looking forward to moving to a short trial.

— Maya

Subject: Re: Action items & SLO proposal for dedicated inference pool (MedNova)

Maya — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with the discussion. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 1k concurrent target is correct for steady-state; during batch report windows we can peak to ~1.6k for ~30 minutes — can your burst policy cover that without violating isolation guarantees?
- For keys: we will provide a customer-managed KMS endpoint in our AWS account; you'll need a cross-account role and a dedicated VPC peering/Transit setup.
- Procurement: we prefer a 12-month committed model, but need to validate pricing bands and any early-termination terms.

Owner confirmations:
- Network/KMS validation: Akash Rao (infra-team@mednova.com)
- Procurement: Lucy Park (procurement@mednova.com)

Please share the intake form and a short checklist for the 72-hour trial. Also flag any data-handling constraints for the trial (we can only provide de-identified samples for the initial run).

Sara
Sara Lin
Head of Platform Engineering, MedNova Health
sara.lin@mednova.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Akash Rao <infra-team@mednova.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Action items & SLO proposal for dedicated inference pool (MedNova)

Akash — forwarding the post-call recap and our proposed draft SLOs. Two quick notes from an ops perspective: 

1) Burst handling: we can allocate a small queued burst lane that preserves tenant isolation and routes overflow to a preemptible pool we control; billing attribution will be tracked by request tags so MedNova sees per-hour usage. This approach keeps PHI off shared multi-tenant hardware.

2) KMS/Cross-account access: we’ll need one service role per environment (staging/prod), and we will provide a CloudFormation snippet to simplify permissions. We will not hold private keys — Redwood will call MedNova KMS endpoints from the peered VPC.

Action for Akash: Can you share the VPC peer CIDR ranges and a point-contact for your KMS admin? We can schedule a 30-min tech design call next week.

Attachments: isolation-ops-playbook-draft.md (notes on queueing and shard mapping)

— Ben 
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

- VPC peerable CIDRs (prod): 10.12.0.0/16, 10.13.0.0/16. Staging: 10.22.0.0/16.
- KMS owner: Priya Nair (priya.nair@mednova.com) — she’ll triage the cross-account policy request.

We are available for a tech design call on 2026-07-06 10:00am PT; please send an invite if that works.

Subject: Re: Action items & SLO proposal for dedicated inference pool (MedNova)

Lucy / Sara — looping procurement with the initial commercial outline and requested timeline. Per our conversation and Akash's notes, here is the plan we propose for the commitment and procurement path: 

Commercial outline (draft)
- Term: 12 months committed
- Baseline capacity: 1,000 concurrent inference sessions
- Burst buffer: up to 60% for 30 minutes/day (metered separately at discounted burst rate)
- Pricing band: monthly committed $XX,XXX — final pricing subject to formal quote (I'll attach the quote template after the tech design call)
- Termination: 60-day notice with pro-rata reconciliation for consumed token-hours beyond commit

Proposed procurement milestones
1) 2026-07-06: Technical design call (Akash / Priya / Ben / Monica / Maya) — confirm KMS/CIDR and trial scope
2) 2026-07-12: Intake form & trial kickoff (de-identified dataset)
3) 2026-07-19: Trial wrap + performance readout and MOP
4) 2026-07-23: Commercial quote sent to Lucy (procurement@mednova.com)
5) 2026-07-30: Target signature window (if trial meets SLOs)

I’ve attached the SLA proposal and playbook draft. If Procurement needs an initial PO or redline language to enable Legal review, flag the priority and we’ll expedite a template.

Thanks everyone — I’ll send calendar invites for the design call and trial kickoff.

— Maya
